TYPE_EDITOR.TITLE: Settings for {{ type }}
TYPE_EDITOR.SUBTITLE: Customize your default {{ type }} settings and meta tags or edit them individually.

PAGES_TABLE.TITLE: {{ type }} ({{ count }})
PAGES_TABLE.SUBTITLE: Select a row to edit each page's basic SEO settings.
PAGES_TABLE.TIP_PAGE_URL: Every URL ends with a 'slug', which should tell people what the page is about. By default, it follows this format: https://your-site.com/<page-slug>/
PAGES_TABLE.TIP_FOCUS_KEYWORD: The focus keyword is the main phrase you want a specific page to rank for in search results. It should be between 2 to 5 words. Include it in the page's title tag, meta description and page content.
PAGES_TABLE.TIP_TITLE_TAG: This is the main title displayed in search results. It's the first thing a potential visitor will read. By default, it follows the format: Page name | Site name.
PAGES_TABLE.TIP_META_DESCRIPTION: Meta descriptions are page summaries displayed on search engines. You can write them individually or set a default for all main pages. If left blank, search engines choose relevant content to display.
PAGES_TABLE.TIP_INDEXABLE: Only pages with a checkmark can be indexed and displayed in search results. If there's no checkmark, you've turned off indexing for the page.

PAGE_EDITOR.TITLE: SEO Settings: {{ pageName }}
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_PREVIEW_GOOGLE: For improved search results, Google may alter this content. Changes to this title and description may take time to update.
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_TITLE_TAG: It's recommended to use 55-65 characters to briefly describe the topic of this page, for example "Power vinyasa yoga classes for beginners in Brooklyn, NY."
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_META_DESC: It's recommended to use 155-165 characters to summarize this page. Note: Whether this is left blank or not, search engines may show a different description.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_STRUCTURED_DESC: Make your pages eligible for rich results and improve how LLMs like ChatGPT process your content.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_ROBOTS_DESC: Select the relevant instructions, so bots know what info to display after crawling this page.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_ADDITIONAL_DESC: Help search engines get important info about this page.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_MULTILANG_TITLE: This page is in multiple languages
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_MULTILANG_BODY: Edits you make here will apply to all versions of this page. Your site automatically includes tags like hreflang and x-default, so no need to worry about those.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_TIP_STRUCTURED: Need a markup? Use an external tool, then paste your code here. Common generators include Google's Structured Data Markup Helper.
PAGE_EDITOR.ADV_MARKUP_BODY: Write your markup in JSON-LD format
PAGE_EDITOR.SOCIAL_HEADER: Open graph (og) tags are used by social networks like Facebook & Pinterest to display text and an image when this page is shared.
PAGE_EDITOR.OG_DESC_PH: Add a description about this page
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_OG_TITLE: When users share this page on Facebook or Pinterest, this title appears.
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_OG_DESC: Short snippet that appears beneath the title on Facebook / Pinterest cards.
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_OG_IMAGE: Image used for Facebook / Pinterest cards. Recommended 1200 × 630.
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_X_SETTINGS: Customize how this page looks when shared on X (formerly Twitter).
PAGE_EDITOR.TIP_X_DESC: Short body text on the X card.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_SUBTITLE: Follow tasks to optimize this page for search engines and visitors.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_FOCUS_HINT: Add a focus keyword to unlock more optimization tasks tailored to it.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_FOCUS_HINT_SET: You'll get more tasks based on this keyword phrase.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_FOCUS_WARN: Changing or removing this keyword will affect your tasks.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_BEST_PRACTICE_1: Use a short, specific phrase of 2 to 5 words.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_BEST_PRACTICE_2: Include the phrase your audience would actually search for.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_BEST_PRACTICE_3: Use a different keyword for every page on your site.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_NOINDEX_BODY: Let search engines index this page by enabling indexing.
PAGE_EDITOR.ASSISTANT_SLUG_REDIRECT_BODY: Link your old URL to the new one and keep your search ranking by setting up a 301 redirect.
PAGE_EDITOR.META_DESC_HINT: Search engines may show a different description
PAGE_EDITOR.DYNAMIC_SLUG_HINT: To change the URL slug of this dynamic page, go to its SEO settings in the editor.
PAGE_EDITOR.INDEX_PAGE_TOGGLE: Let search engines index this page
PAGE_EDITOR.INDEX_OFF_NOTICE: You've turned off indexing on your entire site so it won't show in search results.

BODY.INDEXABLE: Fixing this issue can allow this page to be shown in search results.
BODY.HAS_FOCUS_KEYWORD: Add a focus keyword for this page to unlock keyword-specific tasks tailored to your topic.
BODY.HAS_TITLE_TAG: Your page's title tag is the title that search engines usually display in search results.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_TITLE: Including the focus keyword in the title tag may boost this page's ranking in searches and get more visitors clicking on it.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_H1: The H1 is the most prominent heading on the page. Edit it so it includes your focus keyword.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_URL: When the URL slug appears in search results, visitors and search engines can better understand what the page is about if it includes the focus keyword.
BODY.HAS_META_DESC: Add a meta description so search engines can show a clear summary of this page in results.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_META_DESC: Visitors are more likely to click on this page if the description in search results is clear and relevant to its content.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_BODY: Adding your focus keyword to the main text of the page gives context to search engines and your audience.
BODY.KEYWORD_IN_SUBHEADING: Edit one of your post's H2 or H3 subheadings so that it includes your focus keyword.
BODY.TITLE_LENGTH: Search engines typically truncate titles outside this range. Keep it concise but descriptive.
BODY.META_LENGTH: Aim for 120–170 characters so Google can display the full snippet without trimming.
BODY.IMAGES_HAVE_ALT_TEXT: Search engines can't read images, so add alt text so they (and screen readers) know what each image shows.
BODY.HAS_VISUAL_CONTENT: Videos and images can bring more traffic and make the page more engaging once it's indexed.
BODY.HAS_STRUCTURED_DATA: Structured data markup gives search engines detailed information about your page and can make it eligible for rich results.
BODY.HAS_HREFLANG: hreflang tells search engines the language and geographic targeting of each version of this page.
BODY.HAS_OG_IMAGE: When this page is shared on social networks, an og:image makes the card stand out and increases clicks.
BODY.OG_TITLE_SET: Customize the og:title so social cards read well on Facebook, Pinterest and similar networks.
BODY.MEANINGFUL_SLUG: Use a descriptive slug instead of an auto-generated one like /blank-2 so visitors and search engines understand the page.

TIPS.TITLE_55_65: Title tag should be between 55–65 characters.
TIPS.TITLE_BRIEF: Briefly describe the topic of this page, for example "Easy Homemade Bread Recipe".
TIPS.META_SUMMARY: Give users a summary of this page.
TIPS.META_BLANK_NOTE: If left blank, search engines choose relevant content to display instead.
TIPS.URL_DASHES: Add focus keyword with dashes between words, like "easy-bread-recipe".
